2 bedroom flat to rent, Canal Street, Br: A bright second-floor flat in a converted warehouse next to the canal. The living room has two large windows over the water and an open kitchen with a gas hob and a dishwasher. Both bedrooms fit a double bed; the second one is smaller and has no wardrobe.
The building has a lift, a bicycle store and a secure door with a video entry phone. There is no parking space, but the station is a six-minute walk away. Pets are not allowed. Council tax band B.
